findings.statement: D-061 satisfies the unchanged G-F10-COVARIANCE-METROLOGY pass condition at its declared matched-family scope. Across the five asymmetric f/Pf pairs, N1 weak covariance is at most 8.43e-16 and N2 mass-weighted covariance at most 1.25e-15, both far below 1e-10. N3 native covariance is at most 5.091972401420414e-11 in SA and about 3.53e-11 in SB; all values are below the frozen native caps and below the prospectively frozen B_cov values 0.101 to 0.204. The evidence package explicitly covers the production two-map-plus-add graph: measured self/electron summation shadows and Higham envelopes, off-grid basis equivariance, on-grid basis conditioning A_cond, sector map bounds, E_split for two maps plus native addition and pair folding, D_cov floors and M-ENV ranges, outward mpmath.iv map replay at every family evaluation, and a deep full-node self-assembly interval replay. The operation graph has no numerical mass solve: the dy-orthonormal weak action maps directly through _native_action, so the mass-solve contribution is structurally zero rather than an omitted nonzero error source. The strongest adverse reading is that B_cov is very loose and M-INT-2 is only one node of SA-1, uses captured branch/domain decisions, and is not a fully independent end-to-end MPFR collision implementation. That stronger general-proof standard is not established. It does not overturn the unchanged gate because N1/N2/N3 are separately hard-gated, the remaining nodes are covered for covariance by bitwise event equivariance plus measured Higham shadows, and the contract expressly limits validation to the frozen family and operation graph. The admissible status is therefore VALIDATED for matched-family covariance metrology, not general-state, continuum, absolute-physics, or collision-independent MPFR validation.
